scripts.e2e:build: pnpm run build && pnpm install --dir e2e/playground-deps --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline --ignore-scripts --reporter=silent && ln -sfn ../playground-deps/node_modules e2e/playground/node_modules && e2e/playground-deps/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p e2e/playground/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: oxlint && pnpm --dir packages/dms-mailing/frontend-vue lint && node packages/dms-mailing/scripts/check-locales.mts && node packages/dms-mailing/scripts/check-frontend-dependencies.mts && node packages/dms-mailing/scripts/check-docs-module-version.mts && node packages/dms-mailing/scripts/check-playground-deps-lockfile.mts && node packages/dms-mailing/scripts/check-module-locks.mts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/interface-dms-mailing build && pnpm --dir packages/dms-mailing typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/dms-mailing/frontend-vue typecheck:tests
scripts.test: pnpm run test:repo && pnpm --dir packages/dms-mailing test:layer
scripts.prepare: if [ -e .git ] && command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v lefthook >/dev/null 2>&1 && GIT_DIR=.git GIT_WORK_TREE=. git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then GIT_DIR=.git GIT_WORK_TREE=. lefthook install; fi
